question: For the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, what is the mean decolorization efficiency of the Box-Behnken center-point runs (pH 6.0, 70 mg/L, 0.70 g)?
rendered:
Document: "Acrylic-assisted immobilization of Cu2O-Ag domains on a 3D loofah monolith for adsorption-assisted visible-light photodecolorization"

Page: 11

The Box-Behnken center-point runs yielded decolorization efficiencies of 96.04-98.98%. The mean decolorization efficiency of the center-point runs is therefore:

(96.04 + 96.79 + 97.03 + 96.54 + 98.98) / 5 = 97.24%
